grammar.summary: 本课学习 discover 宾语从句与 surprising 表语。

points.title: 表语形容词 -ing/-ed
points.explanation: surprising 修饰事物（令人惊讶的）；surprised 修饰人（感到惊讶）：It was surprising / He was surprised. 本课标题对照 expensive/uncomfortable 并列形容词。

examples.en: He was amazed at what he discovered.
examples.cn: 他对他发现的东西感到惊讶。

points.title: what 引导宾语从句
points.explanation: He was astonished at what he found. what = the thing that，从句作介词宾语。

examples.en: The man was ordered to pay extra fare.

exercises.q: He turned ___ me for help, even after I had quarrelled with him.
